details: Bitcoin rebounded above $63,000 on July 4th, ending a 10-day streak of spot ETF outflows with $221.7 million in net inflows. This recovery was driven by softer-than-expected US economic data, easing Federal Reserve rate concerns, and significant short-covering liquidations.
title: Bitcoin Rebounds Amid ETF Inflows and Softer US Data

details: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin unveiled a new "Lean Ethereum" roadmap, described as the network's "third major iteration" comparable to the Merge. This multi-year effort (3-4 years) focuses on faster verification, stronger security, and improved scalability, with a redesign of how Ethereum stores data expected to significantly reduce fees.
title: Vitalik Buterin Outlines "Lean Ethereum" Development Roadmap

details: Solana's network added approximately 2 million new addresses in mid-2026, with daily active addresses ranging from 2.5 million to nearly 7 million. Additionally, a Solana-based platform called "World" plans to expand into prediction markets this summer, offering contracts for sports, politics, and macro events, aiming to leverage Solana's speed and Phantom wallet's 20 million users.
title: Solana Network Sees Growth, Expands into Prediction Markets

details: Travel platform Travala announced that over 2.2 million hotels worldwide are now bookable using XRP, marking a significant step in crypto adoption for everyday payments. Ripple is also expanding XRP and RLUSD utility through the XRPL AI Starter Kit, enabling AI agents to facilitate payments on the XRP Ledger.
title: XRP Gains Real-World Utility with Travala and AI Payments

details: Standard Chartered has partnered with Circle to enable direct USDC minting and redemption for institutional clients, removing the need for third-party intermediaries. Separately, BNY Mellon expanded its USDC custody and settlement services, allowing institutions to use its existing systems to custody, mint, and redeem the stablecoin.
title: Major Banks Embrace Stablecoins for Institutional Access

details: MicroStrategy Chairman Michael Saylor stated that Bitcoin's traditional four-year cycle, tied to halving events and retail demand, is no longer the dominant market model. He argues that Bitcoin is transitioning into "digital capital," with its trajectory now primarily shaped by large institutional inflows, spot Bitcoin ETFs, corporate treasuries, and sovereign funds.
title: Michael Saylor Declares End of Bitcoin's 4-Year Cycle, Focuses on Institutional Adoption

details: "Ethereum Institutional," a new independent nonprofit, launched on July 1, 2026. Backed by figures like Joe Lubin, its goal is to serve as a dedicated contact point for financial institutions aiming to utilize Ethereum's tokenized finance rails and integrate with DeFi and enterprise use cases.
title: Ethereum Institutional Launches to Bridge Banks to DeFi

details: The CLARITY Act, a crucial piece of legislation aiming to establish a clearer regulatory framework for digital assets in the US, is progressing through Congress. SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce expressed expectations for its passage this summer, although earlier delays had sparked some uncertainty in the market.
title: CLARITY Act Progresses Through US Congress Despite Delays
